title: Page 91
transc:
Ft Monroe Apr 27 1864
S H Beckwith 
Culpepper CH
for Jupiter unity pandora Rowley has arrived zebra but one
I run clad hear yet pedlar perfume more to come
pekin will not be hear before sund day zodiac maxim
not before Sat her day if then unity plague whips
of his whist behind pekin peach of which are trance
grapes youth Knave flag ghost ante Meridian how are you
Geo D Sheldon


Hd Qrs A. P. Apr 27 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
fanny Knave unity Hotels orchard is at
Wolftown madison county he has plank Quitmans
of his old pelham unity shelby Polk
lately here but we cannot hear of
his whisky we hear that hollands owl
is at Gideon have written & wrangled
you at length but have no answers
youth engrave nice day this up here
Caldwell
